description: Demolish existing first floor rear conservatory and glazing to ground floor extension below.  Erection of a new conservatory and roof to ground floor extension and extend ground floor extension. Insert new window into side elevation at first floor level. Replace existing roof windows over rear side ground floor extension
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (587-L00-00, 587-L01-01, 587-L02-02, 587-L10-02 & 587-L12-02 Received: 08/12/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the side elevation of the original house shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
